STRIX_API_KEY.description: Strix.ai PAT prefixed 'strix_pat_'. Minted at Strix.ai dashboard -> Settings -> API Keys. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

STRIX_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'findings'. Valid: findings (AI-agent-discovered vulns -> Faraday vulns), scans (last N scan runs summarised), targets (registered assets -> Faraday hosts).

STRIX_TARGET.description: Restrict findings to a single target_id. Omit for all targets.

STRIX_STATE.description: Finding state filter. Default 'open'. Valid: open | confirmed | triaged | all.

STRIX_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

STRIX_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for findings. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: strix
title: Strix.ai
description: Strix.ai autonomous AI-pentester import. Bearer PAT (strix_pat_...) against the public REST API (default https://api.strix.ai/v1/). Modes: findings (AI-agent-discovered vulns become Faraday vulns tagged '[AGENT]' on the affected asset, with PoC + remediation folded into the description and CVE/CWE cross-refs), scans (last N scan runs summarised as info-level records so you can see when the last run happened per target), targets (registered assets become Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:strix:target-inventory'). Severity is normalised from Strix's enum into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; STRIX_MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Cursor + page-based pagination; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
